title: LTFRB eyes special bus routes to ease LRT-2 congestion

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) has begun studying special bus routes between Antipolo City and Manila to provide commuters with an alternative when the Light Rail Transit Line 2 (LRT-2) is congested or train services are disrupted. The proposed routes would run between Antipolo and Recto Avenue, with designated bus pickup and drop-off points near LRT-2 stations, the LTFRB said in a statement on Monday.
